hits.snippet: ## Search form Home # iRhythm to acquire rival cardiac monitoring company for $288M artificial intelligence money finance acquisition iRhythm, the San Francisco-based medtech company known for its cardiac remote monitoring technologies, has agreed to acquire industry rival VitalConnect for approximately $287.5 million. This includes approximately $237.5 million in cash and an additional $50 million in common stock. San Jose-based VitalConnect sells the VitalPatch, an FDA-approved wearable biosensor that uses artificial intelligence algorithms to deliver real-time ECG data in addition to other important vital signs. It delivers these data through the cloud, putting helpful information in the hands of clinicians without waiting for patients to mail back the device.
